title: Hey all (regarding futuristic shower)
content: Does anybody ever see Showers, but they’re almost like those walk in body dryers, they aren’t built into the room it’s like a single unit Showers in the middle And two pods that could fit people on the side But they’re open top pods So you have this shower And two things on the outside to lay in standing up kinda Mine was a pink shower unit Pink clear plastic on the pod parts
